messages:
tina_sales: FYI Acme POC run just started returning a bunch of 5xxs during a ramp. Theyre on the demo call and getting nervous. Can we triage quickly?

jasper_se: Which route/model and sample request ids? Any logs from the demo client?

tina_sales: Route `acme-poc-v2`, model `redwood-proto-2`. Seen ids: r-a12, r-a13, r-a14. Load pattern was a stepped ramp 20->120 RPS over 90s.

maya_support: Quick frontline snippets from edge: 
```
[2026-04-02T09:10:17Z] request_id=r-a12 upstream=backend-12 status=502 reason="upstream_overloaded"
[2026-04-02T09:10:19Z] request_id=r-a13 response=503 reason="throttle_queue_full"
[2026-04-02T09:10:45Z] request_id=r-a14 upstream_error: instance_attach_preempted: spot_preempt
```

leo_oncall: Autoscaler logs show scale-out attempts at 09:10:18 and 09:10:30. Cloud provider returned repeated `InstancePreempted` for spot pool; attach retried and finally fell back to shared-burstpool. Burstpool then hit queue depth and returned 503s.

jasper_se: Two approaches: (A) short-term: enable `graceful_degradation=true`, set `soft_limit_rps=50`, enable `fallback_model=redwood-proto-2-quant` and `max_concurrency=1`. (B) medium-term: move POC to a reserved instance to avoid spot preemptions.

tina_sales: Acme would prefer not to degrade model quality too much during demo. Whats the delta if we move to reserved?

maya_support: Reserved single instance (dedicated-small) gets us stable capacity. Pricing delta approx +25% for the POC week, or we can give a temporary credit for the POC to cover overage.

infra-bot: Applying quick patch to route `acme-poc-v2`: {graceful_degradation=true, soft_limit_rps=50, fallback_model=redwood-proto-2-quant, max_concurrency=1} (patch-id patch-7219).

infra-bot: Patch applied. Observed error_rate fall from ~22% to ~4% over 45s. Connections to burstpool reduced, some requests routed to fallback model.

leo_oncall: Opened cloud ticket CH-9988 to request non-spot GPUs in their region and reserve capacity; ETA 36-72h depending on approval. Owner: @jasper_se. Also I'll attach the autoscaler log dump.

jasper_se: I'll own CH-9988 and follow up with procurement. For immediate demo we recommend: (1) accept graceful degradation + quant fallback, (2) offer one-time credit for demo overages, (3) propose dedicated-small reserved for next week.

tina_sales: I'll propose that to Acme on the call. Also they're asking about Private deployment / VPC peering to avoid shared resources.

leo_oncall: Private deployment (VPC + dedicated nodes) is available but requires legal + infra signoff and ~2-3 week lead time. If they need it for compliance we can start scoping.

maya_support: Logging bundle and a short incident summary queued to the Deal record. I'll post the logs and the mitigation steps for Acme after the call.

tina_sales: Owners recap: mitigation applied (maya_support), capacity ticket CH-9988 (jasper_se), infra notes & SOC/KMS question (leo_oncall). Will update CRM and confirm credit.

jasper_se: One last ask: if we still see instance_preempted errors after moving off spot, paste request ids here and I'll escalate immediate attach retries.

tina_sales: Thanks team 44d updating Acme now and will confirm next steps.
